quotes.summary_phrase: Memphis trades Ja Morant to Portland for Chris Murray and Jeremy Grant
quotes.excerpt: Ja Morant gets traded at long last to the Portland Trail Blazers for Chris Murray and Jeremy Grant.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Ja Morant gets traded at long last to the Portland Trail Blazers for Chris Murray, first round pick from three years ago, and Jeremy Grant, veteran wing that the Blazers have.

text_blocks.text: This is obviously not going to be a popular trade for the Grizzlies fan base. Memphis to the very end love Ja Morant, but it's not like the destination kind of came as a surprise, but everybody knew that the Grizzlies had been desperately trying to trade Ja Morant for months, going back to before the deadline and even quietly before that.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: And so a great opportunity for him to start over.

quotes.summary_phrase: The fascinating part of the trade is the Portland side

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: The fascinating part of this trade to me is on the other end, is the Portland end. So you've got Ja Morant, Damian Lillard, Scoot Henderson, Drew Eubanks, Shaden Sharp. I mean the obvious question is, what do the Trail Blazers have cooking?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Well, the interesting thing is it's time, and I'm not sure that was ever in the cards, but it's time to do a contract extension with Scoot Henderson if you're still inclined.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard and Ja Morant starting in the same backcourt
quotes.excerpt: What do you think about the idea of Damian Lillard and Ja Morant starting in the same backcourt?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: What do you think about the idea of Damian Lillard and Ja Morant starting in the same backcourt? Because I think that's where we're headed here. And Dame's got a no-trade clause, so he will not be traded.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Yeah, and I think it will be extremely entertaining if both those guys are on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
